[[Ahtok]] is a scout of the [[Order of the Sunspears]]. He helps out in several quests and later joins the invasion of [[Gandara, the Moon Fortress|Gandara]]. During the invasion he is killed by a siege artillery, and his ghost is sent to the [[Realm of Torment]].

Cliffs of Dohjok:
:''"So, I tried to scare Lonai with some Istani legends about undead, but I don't think she's buying it."''

;In Istan
